title: Withdrawal Protocol for Study of Heavy Metals in Hair with EDX
author: Salvatore Del Prete
materials: Each aluminium foil must be folded

steps.title: Collect Hair Sample
steps.instruction: Collect a pencil-thick strand of hair (or several thinner strands) from the back of the head.

substeps.instruction: Cut hair immediately above the skin, as close to the scalp as possible
Note the length of the hair strand

steps.title: Package Hair in Foil
steps.instruction: Place the lock of hair in appropriate aluminium foil, ensuring the root portion protrudes from the toothed part of the sheet.

substeps.instruction: Repeat this operation for rate A and rate B

steps.title: Seal and Label Samples
steps.instruction: Secure the samples in containers and prepare documentation for transport.

substeps.instruction: Insert the aluminium foil into the appropriate envelope-container
Attach the collection report and the chain of custody form to the envelope

steps.title: Transport Samples
steps.instruction: Deliver rates A and B to the laboratory via tracked priority mail, express courier, or by bringing them in person.
